entities.summary: Joseph Andrew Williams is an American Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Camden since 2025. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Saint Paul and Minneapolis from 2022 to 2024, when he was appointed Coadjutor Bishop of Camden.
